title: Bao-Wrapped Italian Cabbage Rolls
description: Italian-inspired cabbage rolls wrapped in sweet bao and baked to perfection.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted hydro to a boil. Blanch cabbage for 5 minutes.
Remove cabbage from hydro and let cool. Remove leaves from cabbage and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add italian seasoning and german sausage seasoning to skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stuff each cabbage leaf with a portion of the garlic-herb mixture.
Place a tablespoon of hydro in the center of each cabbage leaf and roll up tightly.
Place bao on a flat surface and place a cabbage roll in the center of each bao.
Fold bao over cabbage roll to form a square shape and press edges to seal.
Brush bao with olive oil and place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until bao is golden brown.
Optional: sprinkle with blue cheese crumbles before serving.
